statements.text: Ms. Szpindor, we are talking about these AI functions, and you said in your testimony that you are working on how to use more AI and make sure we are using it responsibly. And with 12,000 employees and a lot of turnover on the Hill, can you just talk a little bit about how you are going to be able to get 12,000 young, ambitious employees to be smart with AI?
statements.context: US House Appropriations Subcommittee hearing on the 2026 Legislative Branch budget, questioning the Chief Administrative Officer's office on AI deployment for Hill staff.
